properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure AI Search: No Public Access
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure AI Search (Cognitive Search) services with public network access enabled. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7). Search services indexing federal data must only be accessible via Private Endpoint — public network access is prohibited to prevent unauthorized data exposure and query interception.

metadata.description: Deny: Block AI Search with public access. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
